Chapter 747: Chapter 32 Why Does This Line Move on Its Own? (Please Subscribe)

In front of the divine gateway, Lin Yuan approached for a closer observation, the two were less than half a meter apart.

A black line of breath, seemingly substantial, prevented the Four Divine Kings and other Level Eleven Perfect legendary powerhouses from crossing.

This sight was incredibly shocking, as even authoritarian beings like the Four Divine Kings displayed looks of doubt and uncertainty, refraining from crossing the line.

At the foot of the mountain.

Tens of thousands from the Myriad Tribes’ Powerhouses widened their eyes.

Within their view of the scene, originally, the Four Divine Kings and five other powerhouses were engaged in a fierce battle.

...

But in the next moment, they all stopped and retreated swiftly, then a figure appeared in front of the divine gateway.

With a flick of his hand, he drew a line and left the message, ‘Those who cross this line shall die.’

What was most unbelievable was that the Four Divine Kings and the five other powerhouses

Really didn’t cross that thin line?

They just let that suddenly emerging figure stand in front of the divine gateway?

“What’s the situation now?”

“Why aren’t the Four Divine Kings fighting anymore?”

“That figure in front of the divine gateway, is he the mysterious powerhouse from Xueyu Ancient Country who emerged two hundred years ago from Human Civilization, who suddenly made a move and deterred the Four Divine Kings?”

“So domineering, ‘Those who cross this line shall die’? He really doesn’t regard the Four Divine Kings at all?”

…..

The Myriad Tribes’ Powerhouses rapidly discussed amongst themselves,

Currently situated on the mountainside, unable to sense the fluctuations of aura at the peak,

They could only make judgments based on the reactions of the Four Divine Kings and other powerhouses.

…

At the mountaintop.

The many Eleventh Rank Powerhouses who had not yet evacuated were watching Lin Yuan in absolute astonishment.

“He’s too strong.”

“How is this Human Civilization’s ‘Blood Rain’ so powerful?”

“As soon as he took action, the Four Divine Kings dared not continue?”

…

One by one, the Eleven Rank Powerhouses got closer and sensed more, leading them to find the situation even more unbelievable.

They had originally thought that among all the Myriad Tribes’ Powerhouses, with the Refining of the supreme weapon, the Four Divine Kings would be the strongest.

Even other Level Eleven Perfect legendary powerhouses, like the slender elder and five others, needed to join forces to barely contend.

Then Lin Yuan suddenly appeared? Note that the outside world had deemed Lin Yuan among the nine great powerhouse levels.

But there was still a significant gap between him and the Four Divine Kings, the slender elder and the other five powerhouses.

…

“Lord Blood Rain…it’s…”

On the side of Human Civilization’s Evolvers, Xuanyuan Dua and other Evolvers were somewhat dazed.

Just over a month ago, they were pleasantly surprised to learn that Lin Yuan also came from Human Civilization.

Based on the strength that Lin Yuan had displayed two hundred years ago, even if he wasn’t quite at the level of superior powerhouses like the Four Divine Kings, he was still strong enough to compete for entrance into the second, third, or fourth opening of the divine gateway.

As for the first opening of the divine gateway? Honestly, Xuanyuan Dua had no expectations at all; accompanying Lin Yuan was just to witness the divine gateway for herself.

After all, she was well aware of the strength of the Four Divine Kings; even if they joined forces with the slender elder and others to confront the Four Divine Kings, the likelihood of entering the divine gateway would probably still be unrelated to Lin Yuan.

Therefore—

From the beginning, Xuanyuan Dua didn’t think this opening of the divine gateway had anything to do with Human Evolvers.

This was a competition among the Innate mighty extraordinary beings.

…

Outside the scroll.

The many Supreme Beings also paid close attention to the scenes atop Heavenly Mountain.

Unable to peer into the Two-Dimensional World, they could only watch the shared memory images of the Myriad Clans’ Powerhouses present on Heavenly Mountain.

“The Four Divine Kings are indeed very strong.”

“The spot for this divine gateway’s opening should belong to the Four Divine Kings.”

“Truly the unique and unparalleled special beings, the treasures of the Star Alliance.”

The Supreme Beings carefully deduced the outcome of the battle through the memory images, which held no surprises for them.

Originally, they were aware that the Four Divine Kings should be the final victors, after all, compared to other Myriad Clans’ Powerhouses, Refining a supreme weapon completely suited to oneself held too great an advantage.

The forces behind the Myriad Clans’ Powerhouses had also considered extinguishing the Four Divine Kings early on, only to end up with the Tianyu Clan being slaughtered and eliminated prematurely.

However.

Just as the Supreme Beings continued their observations,

They were stunned, for through the memory images, they saw Lin Yuan appear and force the retreat of the Four Divine Kings and the other five powerhouses.

“This?”

“Is this an Evolver from Human Civilization?”

“How can he be so strong? Surpassing even the combined force of the Four Divine Kings?”

One Supreme Being after another displayed surprise, as even the Four Divine Kings, to these beings of the Twelfth Rank Ultimate, didn’t seem like much, merely a young individual with prospects of becoming Ultimate.

What surprised the Supreme Beings was the unexpected turn in the battle.

Could there be someone stronger than the Four Divine Kings? And this powerhouse came from Human Civilization?

“Hmm?”

A frown creased the forehead of a Supreme Being from the Star Alliance, who was observing through the memory images of the Four Divine Kings and therefore knew more about the aura Lin Yuan emitted.

“Hmph!”

“No wonder you, Xia Qin, were unwilling to cooperate with me.”

“Your Human Civilization has been hiding deeply.”

The Star Alliance’s Supreme Being looked at the Xia Qin Supreme Being with some dissatisfaction and muttered under his breath.

At this moment, he finally understood why the Xia Qin Supreme Being had previously acted so perfunctorily.

It turned out that Human Civilization didn’t need to rely on the Four Divine Kings to enter the divine gateway.

Although the Four Divine Kings and other powerhouses did not directly confront Lin Yuan, their perceptions allowed them to deduce that the latter was stronger than them—much stronger.

For this opening of the divine gateway, the most hopeful to enter had now shifted from the Four Divine Kings to Lin Yuan.

“Hahaha…”

Xia Qin Supreme Being’s face revealed a smile.

Over the past two hundred years, he also hadn’t pressed Lin Yuan much on his capabilities, feeling that it would create pressure.
